title: The Evolution and Management of Migraine Recurrence Beyond 24 Hours
brief_summary: What is the course of migraine headache recurrence, how is it managed, what characteristics are associated with it, and how does it influence patient satisfaction with treatment?
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female and male patients at University Headache Center with \> 6 month diagnosis of migraine with and/or without aura (ICHD-II)
* Greater than or equal to 18 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Greater than 15 days/month total headache days
* Analgesic use greater than 15 days/month (other than aspirin less than or equal to 325mg/d)
study_population: Patients at the University Headache Center, aged 18 or older, with a diagnosis of migraine with and/or without aura as defined by ICHD-II criteria
